protocol.name: koan_test_v1

description.summary: test control for the Koan Wayland server

protocol.description:
A private protocol for conformance test runners (WLCS) that run inside a VitruvianOS session against app_server's real Wayland socket. It places windows and injects pointer input through app_server's own window management and event dispatching, so tests exercise the real stacking, hit-testing and focus.
The global exists only while the root-owned file /run/koan-test-control is present when app_server starts. Never enable it on a system that runs untrusted clients: it lets a client move windows and inject input.

request.name: move_surface
request.description: Move the native window of the toplevel that owns this surface so that the surface's origin is at (x, y) in screen coordinates. Ignored if the surface has no mapped xdg_toplevel.

request.name: pointer_motion
request.description: Move the pointer to (x, y) in screen coordinates, as a mouse would.

request.name: pointer_button
request.description: button is a Linux evdev code (BTN_LEFT, ...); state is a wl_pointer.button_state value.

request.name: sync

description.summary: wait until earlier requests took effect

request.description: The callback's done event is sent once app_server has handled every earlier request of this object and the Wayland events they caused (pointer enter/motion/button, configure, ...) have been sent to their clients.
